title: Director Mode
summary: Stop editing, start directing: turn one raw talking-head video into a finished post in four levels - cut dead air and retakes, move your strongest proof line to second 1, let an outside judge score the first 3 seconds and fix the top fault, then add free sound effects, word-highlight captions and a title card - with a one-line scoreboard after each; Threadify writes the post and schedules it with the video only after one exact yes. Free, local, and your original is never touched.
triggers: edit my raw video for me
turn my talking head video into a post
cut the dead air and retakes from my video
make my video something people finish

inputs.name: one raw talking-head video file on this computer (60-90 seconds typical), ffmpeg, whisper.cpp with a speech model, optional Threadify connection for the post

outputs.name: director/ folder beside the original with v1 (speed), v2 (altitude), v3 (depth) and final.mp4 (range, 1920x1080, at most 95 MB), a scoreboard line per level, two outside-judge scores, credits.json for sounds, verify result, and optionally one scheduled post with the video and its readback

free_capabilities: local word-timed transcription with whisper.cpp, one speech stretch at a time
dead-air cuts (over 0.3 s down to about 0.1 s) and retake removal that keeps the last clean take, with room tone kept at every join
reorder render: proof line to second 1 and cut lines, from a plan the agent writes
outside-judge packet (contact sheet, first-3-seconds frames and words, rubric) for a fresh subagent or external CLI
Openverse sound effects with a CC0/public-domain licence filter, rate-limit pacing, a local cache and credits.json
loudness-matched mix about 15 LU under the voice with cues kept off word onsets
burned word-highlight captions (lowercase, at most 3 words) and a title card (drawtext or a HyperFrames overlay)
final 1920x1080 30 fps MP4 under 95 MB, verified by full decode, format checks, re-transcription and cut-edge sound checks
local casing guard that proves lower(original) == lower(final) for the post
paid_capability_stubs: optional Threadify post generation counts toward the plan's AI generations
optional connected video upload, scheduling and readback

must_show: the exact final post text and any sound credit line
the final video and its length
action: schedule this post with the video; nothing publishes now

instructions: Never write to the original video; every output goes to the director/ folder beside it.
Never upload the raw video, audio or transcript; only director/final.mp4 is uploaded, and only for the post.
When whisper-cli, a speech model or ffmpeg is missing, report the exact fix from the check command and run it with the owner's knowledge.
When ffmpeg lacks libass, finish without burned captions and say so.
When Openverse is down or over its limit, use cached sounds or none and say so; never use NC, ND or SA sounds, and CC BY only on opt-in with its credit line.
When no fresh subagent or external CLI is available, say the outside judge is unavailable and skip to Level 4; never judge your own edit as the outside judge.
When the judge's second score is not higher, say so plainly and keep the better version.
When verify finds a word missing at a cut that ran through sound, fix the cut before showing the final.
Never write the post yourself when Threadify generation is unavailable; report the blocker and the manual next step.
Never call publish_now; schedule only after the owner's exact yes to the post card, and read the schedule back.
When an upload or schedule outcome is unclear, read back before retrying and retry only with the same idempotency key.

must_prove: dependency check result and speech model used
original file untouched (outputs only in director/)
both outside-judge scores and the fault fixed
sound credits, licences and the measured LU under speech
verify result: plays, 1920x1080, 30 fps, size, words and cut edges
optional post: model, casing guard, upload, approval reply, scheduled slot and readback
